children: Argentina's economic activity fell 1.4% in July compared with the same month a year earlier, data from Argentina's national statistics agency showed on Thursday.
The increase for Latin America's third-largest economy was below the 1.8% growth projected by analysts polled by Reuters and jumped from the 2.7% rise recorded in June.
